method: Exact weighted expectation of one-group random dropout: clean weight 1-p; each of three masked copies p/3; total weight per original row 1
selection: inner 3-fold mean macro-F1 over clean plus three single-group outages, equally weighted; outer fixed 5-fold subject splits
controls: p=0 retuned with same robustness objective; selected arm may choose p=0
preprocessing: fit imputer/scaler on clean training rows only, identical across p; encoder frozen
limitations: Exploratory adaptive reuse of outer folds; simulated outages; selected dropout search has greater search budget than fixed p=0 control; no untouched final test
